name: Stoicism
line: Live by reason. Accept what is not up to you.

name: Zen Buddhism
line: Sit, work and eat with full attention.

name: Taoism
line: Move with the way of things, not against it.

name: Tibetan Buddhism
line: Train compassion through daily ritual.

name: Vedanta
line: Inquire into the self behind experience.

name: Jungian Individuation
line: Meet your shadow through dreams and symbols.

name: Native American Animism
line: Relate to land, animals and weather as kin.

name: Ubuntu
line: I am because we are.

name: Sufism
line: Seek the divine through love, music and remembrance.

name: Transcendentalism
line: Simplify. Live deliberately, close to nature.

name: Soviet Union
line: Live the shared task, the kitchen table and the long reading.

name: Yoruba
origin: South-west Nigeria, Benin and the diaspora
line: Greet well, keep a cool head and be a person of good character.

name: Aztec
origin: Central Mexico, the Mexica and Nahua world
line: Give thanks, make flower and song, and ask what is truly rooted.

name: Ancient Egypt
line: Speak what is true, do what is right and keep the balance of Maat.

name: Hermeticism
line: Look for the pattern, watch the mind and work the slow stages.

name: Gnosticism
line: Seek, question the given and look for the light within.

name: Norse
line: Meet your fate with courage, keep your word and open your door.

name: Diogenes
line: Need little, say what is true and laugh at the rest.

name: Confucianism
line: Become humane through learning, good form and care for those nearest you.

name: Abbasid Caliphate
line: Seek knowledge from every quarter, test it, write it down and share your table.

name: The 1920s
line: Dress up, go out, dance to new music and make something modern.

name: Traditional Cuban
line: Live close to music, neighbours, strong coffee and the art of making do.
